title: Dimension additivity for a short exact sequence of finite-dimensional vector spaces
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $V_1,V_2,V_3$ be finite-dimensional $K$-vector spaces [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], and let $0\to V_1\xrightarrow{f}V_2\xrightarrow{g}V_3\to0$ be a short exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] of $K$-linear maps (so $f$ is injective, $g$ is surjective and $\operatorname{im}f=\ker g$). Then $\dim_K V_2=\dim_K V_1+\dim_K V_3$, with dimension as in [def-weil-vector-space-dimension].

source.place: Tag 08AA, lemma-euler-characteristic-additive, proof: rank-nullity for the finite-dimensional cohomology exact sequence, specialized to three terms.
